title: The dance of the forces
blurb: Why most things on a chart of mass and size fall on one diagonal: electromagnetism against gravity, then the strong force and fusion, then the weak force, from a stick to a neutron star, and the strangest of all, black holes.

segments.to: purely by the force of gravity.

segments.from: And if you add even more mass, a stranger
This is the region where stars go to die

_note: The forces Short from the new take (rec74, 2026-11-17), the author: 'take out just the dance of the forces part and make a short video'. From 'everything in our universe is a delicate dance between four fundamental forces' to 'and the strangest of all, black holes' (the author, 2026-11-17), leaving out what a Short can lose to fit under 3:00: the chemical bonds and their animation, gravity's reach and the round worlds, 'Get massive enough…', the small stars' end, and the recap before the cemetery of dead stars ('So far our objects…'). The old Short (short-l2-dance-of-the-forces, rec58) stays beside it to compare.
